title: Planner: materialize a staged-but-not-live skill (lock/disk divergence)
description: Follow-up from the TASK-120 review (MEDIUM). The assimilate workflow writes a lockfile entry at stage time (per addon-packs-plan.md §7). But src/pack-reconcile.js plan()'s install branch is `!lockEntry && !actualEntry`, so a skill that is IN the lock but NOT live under .claude/skills/ is treated as a no-op and never materialized by plan() alone. Net divergence: after a permissive assimilate with no materialize, the lock claims installed while .claude/skills/<id>/ is absent, and plan() will never propose the install. This blocks driving 'assimilate -> reconcile -> materialize' via plan() in the integrated loop. Fix belongs in the reconciler model (staged-vs-live distinction), not in assimilate. Options: (a) plan() proposes install/materialize when desired && not in actual(live) regardless of lock presence; or (b) introduce an explicit staged vs active state so materialize is derivable. Coordinate with the eventual assimilate->adopt loop wiring.
acceptance_criteria: plan(desired, lock, actual) proposes an install/materialize for a skill that IS in the lock (staged by assimilate) but NOT present in actual (probeSkills of .claude/skills), when it is in the desired set.
A skill that is both in the lock AND live (actual) remains a steady-state no-op (no regression to the existing AC4 behavior).
An end-to-end test drives assimilate -> plan() -> applyPlan and confirms plan() itself (not a hand-constructed install op) triggers the first materialize into .claude/skills/<id>/.
The lock/disk divergence described in the TASK-120 review can no longer occur: after assimilate, a reconcile pass makes lock and live state consistent.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body:
Closed on a clean Reviewer APPROVE (fresh-context, full depth). Review depth = FULL; rubric input: diff touches core tdd-tier reconciler logic (src/pack-reconcile.js), a mandatory-FULL surface the assimilate/materialize pipeline depends on. tdd two-commit discipline confirmed: test commit 68be9c8 strictly precedes fix ad657e0; red-run independently reproduced at the impl parent (staged-but-not-live skill fell through to a no-op under the old !lockEntry && !actualEntry gate). Fix: plan()'s install gate is now 'not live' (!actualEntry) rather than 'neither in lock nor live', so a skill staged by assimilate (lock entry written, not yet under .claude/skills/) is materialized on the next reconcile; the live-path pin-compare/no-op branch is unchanged (AC2 no-regression, pinned by a non-vacuous full-equality assertion). The replace->install semantic shift (a staged-but-not-live pin mismatch is now install, not replace — you cannot replace what is not on disk) was reviewed as LEGITIMATE, not a laundered assertion: each updated existing spec added a matching actual entry to keep testing the genuinely-live case, and the staged case is explicitly covered by a new test. AC3/AC4 e2e drives assimilate(approve)->probeSkills->plan()->applyPlan with plan()'s OWN output (hand-built-op workaround removed), then a second reconcile pass asserts a clean no-op steady state — divergence resolved. Orphan-removal pass (TASK-118 HIGH) untouched. dist-parity: src/pack-reconcile.js is not transitively imported by any bundled entrypoint — no dist rebuild needed (independently confirmed). Gate green: fast tier 770 passed/2 skipped/0 failed, pack-reconcile + assimilate e2e 21 passed. Knowledge capture (TASK-105): not triggered (clean first-pass APPROVE, no HIGH, no RC loop).

Process note: the review flagged a MEDIUM that was the orchestrator's OWN live session bundle failing bundle.schema.json (decisions[0] used a 'summary' key; schema requires decision+rationale, additionalProperties:false) — not caused by this ticket's diff. Repaired by the orchestrator (decisions[0] now uses decision+rationale) and re-verified green; committed with this close.
